column1: # Every user setting of claude-html, in one place: the Settings page, claude-html --config,
# the claude-html://settings link and the docs test all read this file. Tab-separated.
# A line starting @ names a group: @<group> <title>. Then one line per setting:
#   key  group  label  kind  values  default  anchor  flags  help
# A field with nothing in it is written -.
# kind: enum (one of values, |-separated), path, duration (CLAUDE_HTML_GUARD_WAIT's),
#   week (CLAUDE_HTML_WEEK_RESET's), rules, budget, warn (the limits'), text.
# default: the value for an enum, else what applies, in words. anchor: its section in docs/SETUP.md.
# flags, comma-separated: ro (set by ./install.sh only), env (read from the environment only),
#   hidden (not on the page), panel (set in the Limits & budget panel), low:<value> (that value
#   lowers protection, and the confirmation says so).
